title: Freshet
summary: FRESH'ET, n 1. A flood or overflowing of a river, by means of heavy rains or melted snow; an inundation. 2. A stream of fresh water.

inlines.v: FRESH'ET, n 1. A flood or overflowing of a river, by means of heavy rains or melted snow; an inundation. 2. A stream of fresh water.
